sections: Freeze private capture-policy and source-family model

repo_truth: No Snapshot Memory module exists. Generic Projection is private and untouched. This packet creates only the private policy/source-family foundation.
allowed_scope: crates/engine/src/lib.rs: add only a private snapshot_memory module declaration.
crates/engine/src/snapshot_memory/mod.rs, policy.rs, tests.rs, and fixtures/policy-family.json: create private policy/source-family/slot/window/fingerprint types and focused tests.

Use canonical deterministic ordering and DefinitionFingerprint/canonical JSON helpers; require declared live revisions/cursors and reject ambient, duplicate, unknown, malformed, or scope-widening input.
non_goals: Do not add public exports, dependencies, schema/version/defaults, runtime capture orchestration, Projection changes, consumers, HCM-3.5 work, or any external operation.
Do not edit an existing function, class, or method; if unexpectedly necessary, stop and report the exact GitNexus impact before editing.
Do not touch record, delta, redaction, projection, or any fixture other than policy-family.json beyond minimal private module declarations needed to compile.
tasks: Read the dispatch and exact Snapshot policy contracts; establish focused RED tests first.

Implement an immutable private policy model with exact identity/fingerprint, ordered unique source families/slots/static windows, closed triggers/horizons, and explicit comparison/drift/predecessor/redaction/retention selections.
Prove canonical replay and fail-closed duplicate/unknown family/slot/window/trigger/ref/fingerprint/horizon/ambient-source cases.
Run cargo fmt and focused engine tests; return changed files, RED/GREEN evidence, validation, and no-commit status.
contracts_and_gates: Policy identity is independent of live revisions/cursors.
Only declared slots may accept live revision/cursor values.
Every collection/order affecting identity is canonical and closed.
All invalid or scope-widening inputs refuse deterministically.
stop_conditions: Return BLOCKED if the packet needs an out-of-envelope path or a public/schema/dependency decision.
Return BLOCKED before any existing-symbol edit with its upstream GitNexus impact evidence.
